findings.summary: Dragging from the backdrop into the shortcut dialog closes it even though the release/click coordinates are inside the dialog.
findings.expected: Dismiss only a completed outside pointerdown and outside click; an inside release must leave the help dialog open.
findings.actual: At viewport 1440x1000 the dialog is x=440,y=283,w=560,h=434. Pointerdown at (420,303) targets DIALOG; pointerup at (450,293) targets H2. Chromium retargets the click to DIALOG at (450,293); the handler closes the dialog. Reproduced in two fresh archived sessions.
counterexample: Open the exact archived build in a fresh context.
Move to 20px left of the dialog, 20px below its top; press the primary mouse button.
Drag to 10px inside its top-left corner; release.
Observe the dialog close. The drag-out and true outside-click controls pass.

source.detail: The click handler tests backdropDown and event.target===helpDialog, but never tests whether the click coordinates are outside; click target retargeting is insufficient.
